newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks gains curbed by profittaking at close.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks gains curbed by profittaking at close.

text.p: Profit-taking in the afternoon session on Tuesday curbed strong gains made early in Thai stocks by the close, brokers said.
Despite the profit-taking, the SET Index closed at 964.19, up 21.85 points, or 2.32 percent. The SET-50 ended at 74.12 points, up 1.84 points.
"It dropped off in the afternoon, there was some opportunity for profit taking once the market gained 30 points," said Barry Yates, head of research at the Multi-Credit Corporation.
